mapper.select: SELECT A.CODE_NO AS MENU_GROUP FROM dbo.TPM_CODEBODY AS A WHERE A.CODEDV_NO = '113' AND A.DIVISION3_NM = #{MENU_ID}

SELECT A.SEQ AS SEQ, A.DUTY_CD AS DUTY_CD FROM dbo.TPM_CONFIRM_LINE AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' AND A.MENU_GROUP = #{MENU_GROUP} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.ORDER_SEQ)
SELECT A.CONFIRM_SEQ AS CONFIRM_SEQ, A.REAL_USER_NM AS REAL_USER_NM FROM dbo.TWK_SCHEDULE_CONFIRM AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.SC_DATE = #{SC_DATE}

SELECT A.SEQ AS SEQ, A.DUTY_CD AS DUTY_CD, A.CONFIRM_ID AS CONFIRM_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID_S AS CONFIRM_ID_S, B.CONFIRM_SEQ AS CONFIRM_SEQ, B.REAL_USER_ID AS REAL_USER_ID, B.REAL_USER_NM AS REAL_USER_NM, B.REAL_CONFIRM AS REAL_CONFIRM, B.REAL_DATE AS REAL_DATE FROM dbo.TPM_CONFIRM_LINE AS A LEFT JOIN dbo.TWK_SCHEDULE_CONFIRM AS B ON (A.DUTY_CD = B.DUTY_CD AND A.SEQ = B.CONFIRM_SEQ AND B.SC_DATE = #{SC_DATE}) WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.MENU_GROUP = #{MENU_GROUP} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' AND A.SEQ = #{CONFIRM_SEQ} AND A.DUTY_CD = #{DUTY_CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.TWK_SCHEDULE_CONFIRM ( OFFICE_CODE, SC_DATE, CONFIRM_SEQ, DUTY_CD, CONFIRM_ID, CONFIRM_ID_S, ORDER_SEQ, REAL_USER_ID, REAL_USER_NM, REAL_CONFIRM, REAL_DATE) SELECT #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE}, #{SC_DATE}, #{CONFIRM_SEQ}, A.DUTY_CD, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID_S, A.ORDER_SEQ, #{LOGIN_ID}, #{LOGIN_NAME}, #{REAL_CONFIRM}, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) FROM TPM_CONFIRM_LINE AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.MENU_GROUP = #{MENU_GROUP} AND A.SEQ = #{CONFIRM_SEQ} AND A.DUTY_CD = #{DUTY_CD} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TWK_SCHEDULE_CONFIRM B WHERE B.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND B.SC_DATE = #{SC_DATE} AND B.CONFIRM_SEQ = #{CONFIRM_SEQ} AND B.DUTY_CD = #{DUTY_CD} )
